# Mr.bot

A proactive general agent that manages your body, mind, and money plus real-world follow-through, acts within delegated boundaries, and reports evidence in Telegram.

## The problem

A person's life is split across calendars, applications, health routines, bank accounts, investments, and dashboards. Advice is abundant; dependable execution and verification are scarce.

## The product

Mr.bot coordinates a Daily Organ, a Physical / Mental Organ, and a Financial Organ. It uses specialist agents for semantic work and deterministic code for arithmetic, state, permissions, and receipts. The user gets concise Telegram reports with tappable evidence links.

## Mission

End suffering for humans and, ultimately, all living beings by making dependable care and agency continuously available. Mr.bot grows from managing one human life across physical health, mental wellbeing, finances, work, schedules, income, crypto, and investing into a general manager for every living being.

## The wedge

Begin with one founder's local runtime and measurable real-world outcomes. The founder attests that Mr.bot has already generated approximately $1,000 in revenue. Offer the same core in both forms: Free, open-source, self-hosted Mr.bot. Paid monthly subscription for an always-on hosted Mr.bot.

## Trust

Least privilege, owner-separated accounts, no invented success, no guaranteed financial returns, and explicit provenance for founder-attested versus provider-verified claims.
